en.headline: Elderly hiker collapses on Ap Lei Chau hill, airlifted to hospital
en.dek: A man aged about 70 was found unconscious with a head injury while hiking alone on Yuk Kwai Shan on Sunday morning; Government Flying Service helicopter lifted him to Pamela Youde Nethersole Eastern Hospital.
body: Police received a report at about 9.13am on Sunday that a man aged about 70 had collapsed while hiking alone on Yuk Kwai Shan in Ap Lei Chau. He had sustained a head injury and was bleeding.

Fire and rescue personnel gathered at Lei Tung Estate bus terminus before ascending the hill. On arrival they found the man still unconscious. A Government Flying Service helicopter was called in and winched him to Pamela Youde Nethersole Eastern Hospital.
The man required cardiopulmonary resuscitation upon arrival at the hospital. Police are investigating the circumstances of the incident.

zh.headline: 鴨脷洲玉桂山老翁行山昏迷 直升機吊起送院
zh.dek: 一名約70歲男子今日上午獨自行山期間暈倒頭部受傷，消防人員上山後由政府飛行服務隊直升機吊起送往東區醫院，抵院時需進行心肺復甦。
body: 警方今日上午約9時13分接報，指一名約70歲男子在鴨脷洲玉桂山獨自行山期間突然暈倒，頭部受傷流血。
消防及救援人員在利東邨巴士總站集合後上山，到場發現事主仍昏迷不醒。政府飛行服務隊直升機其後將他吊起，送往東區尤德夫人那打素醫院搶救。
事主送抵醫院時需接受心肺復甦法急救。警方正調查事件原因。
